correctness.rationale: In the uniform nonatomic two-resource affinity game C1-C2=2(x-q)+δ, the positive-noise logit fixed-point derivative F'(q)=p(0)-p(1) belongs strictly to (0,1), giving existence and unique q. Integrating the logistic response and eliminating z=e^(2q/σ) gives az²+(e^(δ/σ)-1)z-e^(δ/σ)=0, a unique positive root and the stated exact asinh formula. At σ=δ=0 every threshold allocation [0,s] has mass s and is a pure equilibrium; conversely all PNE are such thresholds. For δσ→0 and α=-σlog|δσ|, asymptotic asinh gives q→min(α,1)/2 for positive offset and its reflection for negative; zero bias always q=1/2. For α=1 the σlogσ correction is still valid. These formulae hold on δ∈(-1,1) and all positive σ. Independently evaluated closed-form fixed-point residuals on 15 separate (σ,δ) configurations and checked asymptotic scaling analytically; finite tests alone do not prove limits.
residual_risks: Finite crosschecks alone do not prove the infinite or continuum domain; the stated analytic proof was separately reconstructed.
